children: Cenntro entered into securities purchase agreements on August 25, 2026 for a private placement of up to 12,800,000 shares of common stock at $3.773 per share, for gross proceeds of about $48.3 million. The company plans to use the funds for working capital and general corporate purposes. The offering, conducted under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(d) and exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation S, remains subject to customary closing conditions, and no shares have been issued yet.
